active_recalls.description: The battery management software may incorrectly calculate the state of charge, potentially causing unexpected power reduction.
active_recalls.remedy: Dealers will update the battery management software at no cost. The update takes approximately 2 hours.
active_recalls.status: Active — Contact your dealer to schedule

active_recalls.description: The rear suspension control arm bolts may not have been torqued to specification during manufacturing, which could lead to loosening over time.
active_recalls.remedy: Dealers will inspect and re-torque or replace the rear control arm bolts at no cost. Approximately 1 hour service time.
active_recalls.status: Active — Contact your dealer to schedule

active_recalls.description: The passenger seat occupancy sensor may intermittently malfunction, potentially affecting airbag deployment in a collision.
active_recalls.remedy: Dealers will replace the passenger seat occupancy sensor at no cost. Approximately 1.5 hours service time.
active_recalls.status: Active — Contact your dealer to schedule

active_recalls.description: A fuel delivery module component may develop a crack, potentially leading to a fuel leak.
active_recalls.remedy: Dealers will replace the fuel delivery module at no cost. Approximately 2 hours service time.
active_recalls.status: Active — Contact your dealer to schedule

recall_general_info.how_to_check: You can check if your vehicle has open recalls by providing your VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) to your Porsche dealer or by visiting the NHTSA website at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
recall_general_info.cost: All recall repairs are performed at no cost to the vehicle owner, regardless of warranty status.
recall_general_info.where_to_service: Recall repairs must be performed at an authorized Porsche dealer.
recall_general_info.timeline: We recommend scheduling your recall repair as soon as possible. Parts availability varies by campaign.
recall_general_info.rental_car: If a recall repair requires your vehicle to be at the dealer for an extended period, a loaner or rental vehicle may be provided. Check with your dealer for availability.
